description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Two Six Technologies is hiring a Full-Stack Software Engineer to build customer-facing product features end-to-end across the user interface, APIs, and database. The role also involves automated testing, code reviews, shared framework contributions, team collaboration, and participation in architecture guilds.
Full Stack Software Engineer owning end-to-end feature design and delivery across UI, APIs, and databases, with testing and reusable components

Responsibilities:
• Own the technical design, implementation, and deployment of features end-to-end. You will solve complex problems and write code across the user interface, API endpoints, and database models to ship complete slices of user value, incorporating AI tools to enhance your workflow and support your decision-making
• Review your teammates’ full-stack pull requests. You will look at the entire feature context rather than just a single layer to ensure overall code readability and maintainability
• Write automated unit and integration tests alongside your feature code as part of your standard development loop, ensuring your features are safe and resilient before deployment
• Identify common patterns in your feature work and work to contribute reusable components or helpers to the shared development platform
• Participate in daily team huddles focused on moving shared objectives forward. You will pair-program and swarm with teammates to clear blockers and solve challenging problems
• Represent your team's technical insights by actively participating in our cross-functional architecture guilds to guide standard company patterns

Requirements:
• At least 1 year of software engineering experience with a recognized anchor specialty (e.g., strong frontend capabilities or backend architecture) paired with a solid working knowledge of the rest of the stack
• Comfort modifying relational database schemas, writing API endpoints, and assembling modern component-driven user interfaces
• A strong understanding of continuous delivery principles
• A passion for peer mentoring and pairing
• Eligibility and willingness to obtain and maintain a DoD Security clearance up to TS/SCI
